column1: SELECT oit.order_id, oit.customer_name, cm.customer_tier, cm.total_orders, oit.product_name, oit.category_name, oit.total_amount, cm.customer_lifetime_value FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01'  LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_customers FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics
SELECT customer_name, total_spent FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics WHERE customer_tier = 'Gold' LIMIT 1000
SELECT customer_tier, COUNT(*) as customer_count FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics GROUP BY customer_tier
SELECT product_name, total_revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary WHERE date_key >= '2024-01-01'
SELECT category_name, SUM(total_revenue) as revenue, SUM(total_quantity_sold) as units FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance GROUP BY category_name
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_segment) as unique_segments FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics
SELECT brand, COUNT(*) as product_count FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance GROUP BY brand HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

SELECT oit.customer_id, cm.customer_name, cm.customer_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) as order_count, SUM(oit.total_amount) as total_spent, AVG(oit.unit_price) as avg_unit_price, cm.customer_lifetime_value FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oit.customer_id, cm.customer_name, cm.customer_tier, cm.customer_lifetime_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) > 5
SELECT * FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics WHERE (customer_tier = 'Platinum' OR customer_tier = 'Gold') AND total_orders > 10 LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance WHERE total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance) LIMIT 1000
SELECT cm.customer_name, cm.total_spent, ss.gross_revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm JOIN apjtechup.gold.sales_summary ss ON cm.customer_tier = ss.customer_tier LIMIT 1000
SELECT category_name, brand, SUM(total_revenue) as revenue, AVG(average_rating) as avg_rating FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance GROUP BY category_name, brand
SELECT date_key, SUM(gross_revenue) as daily_revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary WHERE date_key BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY date_key

SELECT oit.order_id, oit.customer_name, oit.category_name, oit.brand, SUM(oit.quantity) as total_items, SUM(oit.total_amount) as order_total, os.total_revenue, os.total_discount_amount, cm.customer_tier FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.order_summary os ON oit.order_id = os.order_id JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oit.order_id, oit.customer_name, oit.category_name, oit.brand, os.total_revenue, os.total_discount_amount, cm.customer_tier LIMIT 1000
SELECT customer_segment, AVG(total_spent) as avg_spent FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics WHERE customer_segment IN ('High Value', 'VIP', 'Premium') GROUP BY customer_segment

SELECT category_name, COUNT(*) as products, SUM(total_revenue) as revenue, AVG(profit_margin) as avg_margin, MAX(current_price) as max_price FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance GROUP BY category_name

SELECT 'High Risk' as category, COUNT(*) as count FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics WHERE churn_risk_category = 'High Risk' UNION ALL SELECT 'Low Risk', COUNT(*) FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics WHERE churn_risk_category = 'Low Risk'
SELECT customer_tier, AVG(average_order_value) as avg_aov FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics GROUP BY customer_tier ORDER BY avg_aov DESC
SELECT YEAR(date_key) as year, MONTH(date_key) as month, SUM(gross_revenue) as monthly_revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary GROUP BY YEAR(date_key), MONTH(date_key)

SELECT customer_tier,PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_spent) as median_spent, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_spent) as p95_spent FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics GROUP BY customer_tier

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN churn_risk_category = 'High Risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_risk, SUM(CASE WHEN churn_risk_category = 'Medium Risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as medium_risk, SUM(CASE WHEN churn_risk_category = 'Low Risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as low_risk FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics

SELECT cm.customer_tier, cm.customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) as total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.customer_id) as unique_customers, SUM(oit.total_amount) as total_revenue, AVG(oit.total_amount) as avg_order_value, SUM(oit.quantity) as total_items_sold, AVG(cm.churn_risk_score) as avg_churn_risk FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY cm.customer_tier, cm.customer_segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

SELECT pp.product_name, ii.current_stock_level, ss.gross_revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance pp LEFT JOIN apjtechup.gold.inventory_insights ii ON pp.product_id = ii.product_id LEFT JOIN apjtechup.gold.sales_summary ss ON pp.category_name = ss.category_name LIMIT 1000
SELECT category_name, brand, SUM(total_revenue) as revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance GROUP BY category_name, brand WITH ROLLUP
SELECT UPPER(customer_segment) as segment, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(total_spent) as avg_spent FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics GROUP BY UPPER(customer_segment)
SELECT brand, COALESCE(SUM(total_revenue), 0) as revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance GROUP BY brand ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT oit.category_name, oit.brand, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) as orders, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.customer_id) as customers, SUM(oit.quantity) as units_sold, SUM(oit.total_amount) as revenue, AVG(oit.unit_price) as avg_price, SUM(oit.discount_amount) as total_discounts, AVG(cm.customer_lifetime_value) as avg_customer_ltv FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY oit.category_name, oit.brand ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT category_name, COUNT(*) as products, AVG(average_rating) as avg_rating FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance WHERE total_reviews > 10 AND average_rating >= 4.0 GROUP BY category_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
SELECT customer_name, total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) as rank FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics LIMIT 1000
SELECT customer_name, customer_tier, total_spent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_tier ORDER BY total_spent DESC) as tier_rank FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics QUALIFY tier_rank <= 100

WITH top_products AS (SELECT product_id, product_name, total_revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100) SELECT category_name, COUNT(*) as top_product_count FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top_products) GROUP BY category_name

WITH customer_stats AS (SELECT customer_tier, AVG(total_spent) as avg_spent FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics GROUP BY customer_tier), product_stats AS (SELECT performance_tier, AVG(total_revenue) as avg_revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance GROUP BY performance_tier) SELECT * FROM customer_stats CROSS JOIN product_stats

SELECT date_key, gross_revenue, LAG(gross_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_key) as prev_day_revenue, gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_key) as revenue_change FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary ORDER BY date_key LIMIT 1000
SELECT product_name, total_revenue, LEAD(total_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) as next_product_revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance LIMIT 1000

SELECT date_key, gross_revenue, SUM(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_total FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary ORDER BY date_key LIMIT 1000
SELECT date_key, gross_revenue, AVG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date_key ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as moving_avg_7d FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary ORDER BY date_key LIMIT 1000

WITH high_value_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_name, customer_tier, total_spent FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics WHERE customer_tier IN ('Gold', 'Platinum') AND total_spent > 100000), customer_orders AS (SELECT oit.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) as order_count, SUM(oit.total_amount) as order_total, AVG(oit.quantity) as avg_quantity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT oit.category_name, ', ') as categories_purchased FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oit.customer_id) SELECT hvc.customer_name, hvc.customer_tier, hvc.total_spent, co.order_count, co.order_total, co.avg_quantity, co.categories_purchased FROM high_value_customers hvc JOIN customer_orders co ON hvc.customer_id = co.customer_id ORDER BY hvc.total_spent DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT customer_name, total_spent, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_spent) as spending_quartile FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics LIMIT 1000
SELECT date_key as date, gross_revenue as revenue FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary ORDER BY date_key LIMIT 1000

SELECT product_name, category_name, total_revenue, AVG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) as category_avg_revenue, total_revenue - AVG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) as revenue_vs_category_avg, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY total_revenue) as percentile_rank FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance LIMIT 1000

SELECT oit.order_date, oit.customer_tier, oit.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) as orders, SUM(oit.quantity) as items_sold, SUM(oit.total_amount) as revenue, AVG(os.avg_discount_percentage) as avg_discount_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cm.is_discount_sensitive = true THEN oit.customer_id END) as discount_sensitive_customers FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.order_summary os ON oit.order_id = os.order_id JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oit.order_date, oit.customer_tier, oit.category_name ORDER BY oit.order_date, revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT oit.customer_id, cm.customer_name, cm.customer_tier, oit.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) as category_orders, SUM(oit.total_amount) as category_spend, cm.favorite_category, CASE WHEN oit.category_name = cm.favorite_category THEN 'Favorite' ELSE 'Other' END as category_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oit.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(oit.total_amount) DESC) as spend_rank FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oit.customer_id, cm.customer_name, cm.customer_tier, oit.category_name, cm.favorite_category QUALIFY spend_rank <= 3 LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly_customer_spend AS (SELECT oit.customer_id, cm.customer_name, cm.customer_tier, YEAR(oit.order_date) as year, MONTH(oit.order_date) as month, SUM(oit.total_amount) as monthly_spend, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) as monthly_orders FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oit.customer_id, cm.customer_name, cm.customer_tier, YEAR(oit.order_date), MONTH(oit.order_date)) SELECT customer_name, customer_tier, year, month, monthly_spend, monthly_orders, LAG(monthly_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY year, month) as prev_month_spend, (monthly_spend - LAG(monthly_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY year, month)) / NULLIF(LAG(monthly_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY year, month), 0) * 100 as spend_growth_pct FROM monthly_customer_spend ORDER BY customer_name, year, month LIMIT 1000

SELECT date_key, year, month, SUM(gross_revenue) as revenue, SUM(gross_profit) as profit, AVG(gross_margin_percentage) as margin, SUM(total_orders) as orders, LAG(SUM(gross_revenue), 1) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) as prev_month_revenue, (SUM(gross_revenue) - LAG(SUM(gross_revenue), 1) OVER (ORDER BY year, month)) / NULLIF(LAG(SUM(gross_revenue), 1) OVER (ORDER BY year, month), 0) * 100 as revenue_growth_pct FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary GROUP BY date_key, year, month ORDER BY year, month LIMIT 1000

SELECT oit.product_name, oit.category_name, oit.brand, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.customer_id) as unique_buyers, COUNT(DISTINCT oit.order_id) as total_orders, SUM(oit.quantity) as units_sold, SUM(oit.total_amount) as revenue, AVG(oit.unit_price) as avg_price, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cm.customer_tier = 'Gold' THEN oit.customer_id END) as gold_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cm.customer_tier = 'Platinum' THEN oit.customer_id END) as platinum_customers, AVG(cm.customer_lifetime_value) as avg_buyer_ltv, SUM(oit.total_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT oit.customer_id), 0) as revenue_per_customer FROM apjtechup.gold.order_items_transactional oit JOIN apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics cm ON oit.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE oit.order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oit.product_name, oit.category_name, oit.brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oit.customer_id) > 10 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

WITH customer_metrics_enhanced AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_name, customer_tier, total_spent, customer_lifetime_value, predicted_ltv_12m, days_since_first_order, total_orders, CASE WHEN days_since_first_order > 0 THEN total_spent / days_since_first_order ELSE 0 END as daily_value, CASE WHEN total_orders > 0 THEN days_since_first_order / total_orders ELSE 0 END as avg_days_per_order FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics) SELECT customer_tier, COUNT(*) as customers, AVG(customer_lifetime_value) as avg_current_ltv, AVG(predicted_ltv_12m) as avg_predicted_ltv, AVG(daily_value) as avg_daily_value, PERCENTILE(customer_lifetime_value, 0.5) as median_ltv, PERCENTILE(customer_lifetime_value, 0.9) as p90_ltv FROM customer_metrics_enhanced GROUP BY customer_tier ORDER BY avg_current_ltv DESC

WITH sales_cube AS (SELECT date_key, year, quarter, month, region, category_name, brand, customer_segment, SUM(gross_revenue) as revenue, SUM(gross_profit) as profit, SUM(total_orders) as orders, SUM(total_units_sold) as units, AVG(average_order_value) as aov FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary GROUP BY date_key, year, quarter, month, region, category_name, brand, customer_segment) SELECT year, quarter, region, category_name, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(profit) as total_profit, SUM(orders) as total_orders, AVG(aov) as avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, quarter ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC) as revenue_rank, SUM(revenue) / SUM(SUM(revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY year, quarter) * 100 as revenue_share_pct FROM sales_cube GROUP BY year, quarter, region, category_name ORDER BY year, quarter, total_revenue DESC

WITH customer_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_customers, SUM(total_spent) as total_customer_value, AVG(total_orders) as avg_orders_per_customer, SUM(CASE WHEN churn_risk_category = 'High Risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_risk_customers FROM apjtechup.gold.customer_metrics), product_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_products, SUM(total_revenue) as total_product_revenue, AVG(average_rating) as avg_product_rating, COUNT(CASE WHEN performance_tier = 'Top Performer' THEN 1 END) as top_products FROM apjtechup.gold.product_performance), inventory_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_skus, SUM(inventory_value) as total_inventory_value, SUM(CASE WHEN needs_reorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as items_needing_reorder, AVG(inventory_turnover_ratio) as avg_turnover FROM apjtechup.gold.inventory_insights inv), sales_summary AS (SELECT SUM(gross_revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(gross_profit) as total_profit, AVG(gross_margin_percentage) as avg_margin, SUM(total_orders) as total_orders FROM apjtechup.gold.sales_summary WHERE date_key >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) SELECT 'Business Overview - Last 30 Days' as report_title, cs.total_customers, cs.total_customer_value, cs.avg_orders_per_customer, cs.high_risk_customers, ps.total_products, ps.total_product_revenue, ps.avg_product_rating, ps.top_products, inv.total_skus, inv.total_inventory_value, inv.items_needing_reorder, inv.avg_turnover, ss.total_revenue, ss.total_profit, ss.avg_margin, ss.total_orders, ss.total_revenue / NULLIF(ss.total_orders, 0) as revenue_per_order FROM customer_summary cs CROSS JOIN product_summary ps CROSS JOIN inventory_summary inv CROSS JOIN sales_summary ss
